plan: This is a single-round auction, so long-term profit maximization simplifies to maximizing profit in this round. In a second-price auction with rational bidders, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy. This is because bidding below your value risks losing a profitable auction, and bidding above your value risks winning an auction at a loss. Since my value is $39, I will bid $39.
